name: Jatin Kataria
biography: Jatin Kataria is the Principal Research Scientist at Red Balloon Security where he architects defensive technologies for embedded systems. Playing both the role of cat and of mouse at Red Balloon has many suggesting that he may be the first real source of perpetual energy. He tires of n-days easily and is always looking for new and exciting ELF shenanigans, caching complications, and the Fedex guy who lost his engagement ring. Prior to his time at Red Balloon Security, Jatin worked at a number of firms as a systems software developer and earned his Master of Engineering at Columbia University. Twitter: @jatinkataria
